---
title: "Combined UMAP + VAE Dimension ANOVA"
subtitle: "Side-by-side comparison of ANOVA (value ~ demcat) across methods and thresholds"
---

## Overview

This document computes ANOVA (dim_value ~ demcat) for each of the 6 latent dimensions from both UMAP and VAE across thresholds 8 and 7, then visualizes the combined results with a faceted barplot, a heatmap, and a line plot.

## Load Packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, install = FALSE)
conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Load Data

Load embedding data from both methods and both thresholds, rename columns to generic `dim_1:dim_6`, pivot to long format, and combine.

```{r}
#| label: load-data

methods <- list(
  UMAP = list(
    path_template = \(th) here(glue("UMAP/lite/output/embedding_threshold_{th}.rds")),
    col_prefix = "umap_"
  ),
  VAE = list(
    path_template = \(th) here(glue("VAE/lite/output/embedding_threshold_{th}.rds")),
    col_prefix = "vae_"
  )
)

thresholds <- c(8, 7)

long_all <- map(names(methods), \(method) {
  info <- methods[[method]]
  map(thresholds, \(th) {
    read_rds(info$path_template(th)) |>
      rename_with(
        \(x) str_replace(x, paste0("^", info$col_prefix), "dim_"),
        starts_with(info$col_prefix)
      ) |>
      pivot_longer(
        cols = dim_1:dim_6,
        names_to = "dim_dir",
        values_to = "dim_value"
      ) |>
      mutate(method = method, threshold = th)
  }) |>
    list_rbind()
}) |>
  list_rbind()

glimpse(long_all)
```

## Compute ANOVA

Compute ANOVA p-value for each method-threshold-dimension combination (24 rows), add -log10(p) and rank within each method-threshold group.

```{r}
#| label: compute-anova

anova_all <- long_all |>
  summarise(
    p = anova(lm(dim_value ~ demcat))$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    .by = c(method, threshold, dim_dir)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    nlog10_p = -log10(p),
    label = sprintf("italic(P) == %.2e", p) %>%
      str_replace_all("e", " %*% 10^"),
    dim_rank = rank(p),
    method_threshold = glue("{method} Thr {threshold}"),
    .by = c(method, threshold)
  )

anova_all
```

## Plot 1: Faceted Barplot

ANOVA -log10(p) barplot for each method-threshold combination, with dimensions independently ordered by significance within each facet.

```{r}
#| label: fig-anova-barplot
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

plot_barplot <- anova_all |>
  mutate(
    dim_key = paste(method, threshold, dim_dir, sep = "___"),
    dim_key = reorder(dim_key, p, .desc = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = nlog10_p, y = dim_key)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
    size = 8, size.unit = "pt",
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.35))) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = \(x) str_remove(x, "^.*___")) +
  facet_wrap(~ method_threshold, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = expression(-log[10](ANOVA~italic(p)*"-value")), y = "Latent dimension")

plot_barplot
```

## Plot 2: Heatmap

Heatmap of -log10(p) values with dimensions ranked by significance (rank 1 = most significant) across method-threshold combinations.

```{r}
#| label: fig-anova-heatmap
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

mid_val <- mean(range(anova_all$nlog10_p, na.rm = TRUE))

plot_heatmap <- anova_all |>
  mutate(
    tile_label = paste0(dim_dir, "\n", round(nlog10_p, 2))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = dim_rank, y = method_threshold, fill = nlog10_p)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = tile_label), size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "white", mid = "yellow", high = "darkred",
    midpoint = mid_val, name = expression(-log[10](ANOVA~italic(p)))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:6, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = "Dimension Rank (1 = Most Significant)",
    y = "Method / Threshold"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

plot_heatmap
```

## Plot 3: Line Plot

-log10(p) across dimension ranks for each method-threshold combination, with line type distinguishing methods.

```{r}
#| label: fig-anova-lineplot
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

plot_line <- anova_all |>
  mutate(threshold_label = paste0("THR", threshold)) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = dim_rank, y = nlog10_p,
    color = threshold_label, linetype = method
  )) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(UMAP = "solid", VAE = "dashed")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("THR8" = "#E41A1C", "THR7" = "#377EB8")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:6) +
  labs(
    x = "Dimension Rank (1 = Most Significant)",
    y = expression(-log[10](ANOVA~italic(p)*"-value")),
    color = "Threshold",
    linetype = "Method"
  )

plot_line
```

## Save Outputs

Save all three plots as PNG and RDS, plus the ANOVA results tibble. Using `grDevices::png` device to render plotmath `%*%` correctly as multiplication sign.

```{r}
#| label: save-outputs

output_dir <- here("VAE_UMAP_comb/output")
fs::dir_create(output_dir)

ggsave(
  here(output_dir, "fig_anova_barplot.png"),
  plot_barplot, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300,
  bg = "white", device = grDevices::png
)
write_rds(plot_barplot, here(output_dir, "fig_anova_barplot.rds"))

ggsave(
  here(output_dir, "fig_anova_heatmap.png"),
  plot_heatmap, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300,
  bg = "white", device = grDevices::png
)
write_rds(plot_heatmap, here(output_dir, "fig_anova_heatmap.rds"))

ggsave(
  here(output_dir, "fig_anova_lineplot.png"),
  plot_line, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300,
  bg = "white", device = grDevices::png
)
write_rds(plot_line, here(output_dir, "fig_anova_lineplot.rds"))

write_rds(anova_all, here(output_dir, "anova_all.rds"))
```
